description: Prepare one reproducible, literature-supported Reactome-context development comparison using existing Pharos data and native PyKEEN. This backlog ends at validated preparation and guarded execution handoff; it does not authorize a real assay comparison or claim biological improvement.
guardrails: Follow AGENTS.md. Check actual dependency versions, official documentation and published methods before custom work. Reuse existing verified code where compatible; explain any remaining integration gap.
Use only the selected saved Pharos snapshot and original graph inputs. Do not retrieve a newer source, introduce another resource, change eligibility or sweep models, thresholds, seeds or features.

INMC is consumed development material. Keep outcomes and known derivatives outside predictor inputs. Preserve the original comparison, exposure ledger, frozen packets, scripts, scorer and all historical result hashes.
Do not read, list, hash, search or query reserved IntAct interaction files or their contents. Do not widen final-study allowlists or run the reserved assessment.

Only synthetic CPU fitting is permitted in this backlog. No fitting on the real assay graph, actual assay scoring, real-graph resource fitting, Brev access, paid compute, model-server calls, AWS provisioning, deployment, email or GitHub push.

A passing story means engineering acceptance criteria are satisfied. A biological gain is never an acceptance criterion. Record failures and stop on unresolved source semantics rather than inventing a mapping.

The exact-device resource check, final execution freeze, six real model fits and consumed-panel scoring are a subsequent announced phase. Do not mark the real execution packet fully frozen without its actual passing runtime proof.

userStories.title: Prepare source-bound Reactome paired graphs
userStories.description: As a researcher, I need the selected Pharos pathway context represented in a matched graph pair so the comparison tests one known information family rather than a change in population or source release.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement a separate versioned preparation entry point for this experiment; do not change the historical GO-only projection or weaken its validations. Reuse existing source-manifest, original-identity and product-mapping helpers where their contracts fit.

Verify the selection record and original source/graph bindings before use. Read only declared snapshot members. Baseline triples, original supervision, candidate identities, split and equivalence masks reproduce the pinned originals.

Add only exact source-listed human Reactome product-to-pathway memberships. Preserve stable IDs, source locators, raw-row hashes, qualifications and every inclusion/exclusion reason. Sharing a pathway never creates a protein-pair or direct-binding assertion.

Both arms share the same ordered union entity and relation vocabularies. The intervention-minus-baseline edge difference equals precisely the eligible membership ledger; neither arm contains direct Pharos PPI context or added GO hierarchy edges.

Produce actual source and eligible-projection counts, duplicate/conflict dispositions and outcome-independent endpoint coverage, including absent context. Available inventory counts 11,138 memberships / 982 products / 1,490 pathways are source checks, not assumed learner-edge counts.
Preserve all original candidates, including those with zero Reactome context. Construct the predeclared 0/1/2 endpoint-coverage diagnostic without loading outcome values or computing assay metrics.

Synthetic tests cover invalid or conflicting pathway IDs, duplicates, unknown products, shared product mappings, absent context, changed source hashes and attempts to add direct protein-pair edges. Relevant existing source/projection tests pass with required dependencies actually present.

Save a source-bound preparation receipt and update current readiness documentation with measured counts and remaining limits. No experiment training, scientific scoring or reserved-source access occurs.
userStories.notes: The existing scripts/prepare_inmc_graphs.py intentionally excludes non-GO families. The workbench and standard export already handle exact Reactome membership. Use those established semantics; do not infer molecular form, pathway role or direct binding.

userStories.title: Verify the two-arm native learner path
userStories.description: As an evaluator, I need a tested two-arm execution path so any later score change can be attributed to the selected context addition under matched training conditions.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement a separate versioned two-arm profile or adapter using the tested PyKEEN 1.11.1 / torch 2.6.0 native R-GCN approach. Preserve historical prepare/run/freeze/scoring scripts and their original contracts. Avoid a new learning algorithm or a generic experiment framework.

Require exactly rgcn_baseline and rgcn_reactome, with selected seeds 17/43/101, three layers, 32 dimensions, four bases, SoftplusLoss, Adam 0.001, 20 epochs, batch size 4096 and 16 typed negative proposals per positive. Plan 500 optimizer updates per arm/seed and 3000 across six full runs; verify the actual schedule before real execution.

Preserve supported disabled-dropout and ordinary native batching behavior. Enforce identical per-seed initialization, positive minibatch schedules, supervision, candidate/development identity filters and optimizer update counts; retain fingerprints for later audit.

Reject changed graph/source/code hashes, unsafe paths, mismatched vocabularies or masks, forbidden relation deltas and incomplete arm/seed runs. A resource-check mode must never score actual assay candidates.

Use invented CPU cases to exercise actual message passing through the membership relation and the original gene-to-product links, with shared vocabulary and missing-context endpoints. Tiny synthetic controls may use fewer updates, explicitly separated from the fixed 500-update real-run budget. Verify finite predictions and paired parameter/batch fingerprints using installed native dependencies; skipped native checks do not count as completion.

Keep all real-data commands dry during this story. Record synthetic proof and intended runtime requirements. Report a dependency or semantics blocker rather than changing the selected model, budget or experiment.
userStories.notes: The old runner is specifically guarded for three graph adjacencies, GO is_a enrichment and four model arms. It cannot execute this two-arm design unchanged. Reuse its established native-library behavior under a new explicit contract; do not repurpose old predictions or falsify old proof receipts.

userStories.title: Prepare guarded freeze and scoring handoff
userStories.description: As a researcher, I need one auditable handoff from validated graphs to fixed execution and reporting, so the subsequent comparison can run once and retain an interpretable negative or positive result.
acceptanceCriteria: Prepare separate source/code/graph/scorer/runtime binding and freeze commands compatible with this two-arm profile. Reuse verified file safety, native metric and original assay-eligibility helpers where possible, preserving historical scripts and receipts.

A real freeze requires actual passing synthetic controls plus resource proof for the exact graph, runner and intended device/runtime. Missing, stale or synthetic-only resource proof leaves the real packet explicitly not frozen and real fitting blocked.

Implement the fixed reporting contract on invented outcomes: same bidirectional aggregation, original eligibility semantics, AP primary, ROC-AUC secondary, every paired seed delta and their mean, coverage strata, coverage-only diagnostic and descriptive leave-one-gene-out influence.

Require complete finite predictions for every eligible pair; no arm-specific removal or favorable subset. The real denominator remains the original 1751 eligible off-diagonal pairs; synthetic fixtures use their own declared denominator and cannot impersonate that real-data check. Missing outputs and empty strata remain explicit, with no formal significance or independent-validation claim.

Exercise the full prepare/validate/freeze/score wiring using synthetic fixtures only. Tests cover incomplete predictions, mismatched runtime/code/graphs, corrupt proof, changed candidates and masks, zero coverage, tied coverage scores and negative or mixed model deltas.

Provide exact next commands and a preparation receipt for the saved real graphs, explicitly pending actual-device resource check and final freeze. Verify required native checks; do not load real outcomes or perform actual resource fitting during backlog execution.

Update the active build plan with completed engineering evidence and remaining scientific limits. Do not change the midpoint report to claim measured biological improvement or independent usability. Stop after readiness; ask the root orchestrator to announce the separate compute phase.
userStories.notes: A completed loop prepares a correctly guarded comparison; it is not the comparison itself. A later fixed negative result is a valid scientific deliverable. No score-driven implementation loop or automatic acceptance/pruning is authorized.
